tasks.evidence: [task=bug-cache-race-001] src/cache.py load_cache race condition: read version before lock then stale cache replaces newer value. Root cause: version check outside lock. Fix: compare version under lock before replacement. Failed attempt: increasing TTL does not fix race. Validation: pytest tests/test_cache.py passed.

distractors.text: src/cache.py load_cache race condition: stale cache in async adapter. Root cause: missing await. Fix: await refresh task. Validation: test_async_cache passed.
src/cache.py load_cache tried increasing TTL; race remained and stale values still replaced fresh cache.
